# agentic-analytics

Score social post results and recommend the next move.

Keywords: analytics,social,metrics,agentic-suite,cli,mcp.

- SDK: import { summarizeText, dispatchText } from "agentic-analytics".
- CLI: agentic-analytics summary --text "...".
- MCP: run agentic-analytics mcp, then call summarize_text.
